messages:
sara_support: customer racked a 403 when switching between orgs in the Console, repros for them intermittently. they said it started after their IdP federation change last night. raising because billing/admin tabs blocked. ticket #INC-12987 link: https://redwood.support/t/INC-12987 :exclamation:

miguel_engineering: can you paste the exact console flow and the error modal? is this web UI only or also API/CLI?

sara_support: UI only so far. customer clicks org switch -> spinner -> toast: "Permission denied (403)". they can still list orgs in API, and some members can switch fine. affected users mostly external contractors.

lee_cs_manager: cc @miguel_engineering and @jenna_privsec. we tried resending invite and clearing cache. fixed for one user after force-relogin, but came back after 30m.

miguel_engineering: interesting. sounds like session claim mismatch between SSO assertion and our cached session/roles. did they change group mappings or role claim names?

sara_support: customer says they renamed a SCIM group from "eng-contractors" -> "external-eng" and updated IdP claim to use group_display_name. SCIM sync reported success.

idp_bot: SCIM sync completed (2024-12-03T03:12:14Z) - 142 members processed, 1 warning: group id preserved, display_name changed.

miguel_engineering: two hypotheses: 1) we still have a stale session claim with old group name in JWT -> cached roles fail on org-switch, causing 403. 2) our role-binding lookup uses group id in some code paths and display_name in others -> transient mismatch.

tim_oncall: I pulled the runtime logs for the console route /api/orgs/switch. seeing 401 on the token introspect for some requests, and 403 from role-resolver: 
```
2024-12-03T04:01:21Z INFO request_id=abc123 user=acct-ext-42 org=org-77 action=switch status=403 reason=role_not_found groups=["eng-contractors"]
2024-12-03T04:01:21Z DEBUG token_claims={"sub":"acct-ext-42","groups":["external-eng"],"exp":1701620000}
```

miguel_engineering: aha — token_claims.groups shows external-eng but role lookup used eng-contractors. that suggests a race: cached role mapping keyed by old display name. can you confirm whether our role cache invalidation runs on SCIM change events?

jenna_privsec: we publish SCIM events to the internal event-bus. the consumer that invalidates role-cache subscribes to group.updated events. I see a processed event at 03:12 but the cache eviction job log shows error: 
```
2024-12-03T03:12:15Z ERROR evictor group-update-fanout failed: KeyError 'display_name'
```

miguel_engineering: KeyError during eviction explains it. bug likely from refactor where we assumed display_name always present. when eviction failed, old key stuck and incoming requests map to name not present -> 403.

sara_support: ok customer impact: intermittent — if user has session with cached roles that point to old key, switching hits the stale map and 403. if they re-login and get fresh token and our role-resolver falls back to group id path, sometimes it works. odd that it returned after 30m for one user.

lee_cs_manager: what's the mitigation for customers while we fix? they are blocked from billing page edits.

miguel_engineering: short term: 1) ask affected users to fully sign out from SSO and clear cookies (force new token claims). 2) run a manual job to evict role cache entries for that customer org (we can do per-org). I can run eviction for org-77 now.

tim_oncall: i'll run the eviction script: `scripts/evict_role_cache --org org-77 --force` and watch logs.

idp_bot: eviction job started (2024-12-03T04:15:02Z) for org-77 by tim_oncall.

tim_oncall: eviction completed, no errors. logs show role-resolver now mapping to group id path.

miguel_engineering: i'll deploy a hotfix to the evictor to guard missing display_name and ensure group.id fallback. PR #4523 queued for review.

jenna_privsec: also double-check SCIM schema — some IdPs don't send display_name when rename is via UI vs API. we should harden consumer.

lee_cs_manager: customer updated — two users re-tested and can access billing now. one contractor still sees 403; asked them to sign out and retry.

sara_support: customer asked if this would recur with further renames. suggested ETA for permanent fix?

miguel_engineering: ETA: patch merged + rolling deploy in ~45m, then I'll backfill eviction for orgs with recent group.display_name changes in last 24h. after patch we should be safe.

lee_cs_manager: thanks. I'll update ticket INC-12987 and add postmortem checklist for idp group-renames.

sara_support: thanks all :thumbsup: will message customer and mark as high-priority until patch is live.
